Funded rewards — general limits: The first request normally opens 14 days after the first funded trade. For accounts of $100K or more, each of the first two reward requests is capped at $10,000; the minimum request is $100. The stated 24-business-hour guarantee starts after a payout is approved.

Instant Funding Standard — hard loss limits: The model has a 3% daily equity/balance-based loss floor, resetting at 00:00 UTC, and a 5% maximum loss floor trailing upward at daily reset. The higher balance or equity at the reset determines the reference.

Instant Funding Standard — floating-loss strikes: If combined floating PnL reaches minus 1% of the initial balance, the first occurrence cuts the payout split to 50%, the second cuts it to 25%, and the third closes the account.
